iterations.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / stylized-concept. Create ONE new premium full-body LG clan avatar illustration, portrait 2:3, ideally 1024x1536 or larger. Reference image 1 (nurse Heeya) is the PRIMARY exact facial identity, hair, skin tone, expression and body reference. This is the same clearly adult fictional woman, age mid-20s. Preserve her soft oval face, warm brown irises, delicate nose, softly smiling pink lips, dark espresso shoulder-length layered bob with natural wispy strands, gentle head tilt and sophisticated semi-real 2D painted rendering. Preserve the reference's bust volume, shoulder width, torso, waist and hip volume; do NOT slim her whole body, flatten her chest or change her face. The ONLY physique change is moderately more slender thighs and calves with a graceful taper to the ankles, natural joints and an elegant long-leg line, not skeletal or unnaturally elongated. Reference image 2 (male LG avatar) is ONLY the existing clan's white/black/magenta/silver visual identity and small LG crest reference, NOT a face, body, hairstyle or pose reference.
Design a genuinely new elegant LG clan officer uniform: impeccably fitted pearl-white long-sleeved tailored jacket with black satin lapels and cuffs, precise restrained magenta piping, two clean rows of small polished silver buttons, a narrow tailored waist and tasteful neckline. A small embroidered silver-and-magenta LG crest on the left chest, not an enormous logo. Matching high-waisted fitted black mini skirt with a single magenta side panel and clean tailored seams; natural upper-thigh length, opaque fabric. Sleek black heeled ankle boots with restrained silver details leave the slender leg silhouette visible. Keep all clothing coherent and refined, not bulky fantasy armor. Remove the nurse cap, medical symbols, case, floating medical magic and hospital accessories. No hat covering her recognizable hair, no weapons, no extra bags. Relaxed full-body standing pose with subtle contrapposto, one arm naturally resting near her hip and the other relaxed with visible anatomically correct fingers. No exaggerated pinup arch. Her face is recognizable and receives the highest detail.
Environment: a sophisticated LG clan command-gallery atrium with dark charcoal stone, pearl-white architecture, subtle magenta accent lighting and a single restrained clan standard. Elegant depth, soft distant architecture, controlled reflections, no clutter. Soft bright frontal daylight on the face, gentle silver/magenta rim light tying her to the environment. Retain the delicate painterly game-illustration quality of the nurse reference, not cosplay photography, not rough hyperreal skin, not a plastic 3D render. Head-to-toe composition with both boots and soles completely inside the frame, 5 percent air above hair and below shoes, dominant character with clear face, hips, thighs and calves. No UI, border, title, serial, watermark, statistics, Korean lettering or captions. Only the tiny LG crest may contain the letters LG. One single finished illustration, no comparison layout.

Use case: identity-preserve character revision. Produce ONE revised full-body portrait LG Heeya avatar illustration, 2:3 portrait, 1024x1536 or larger. Image 1 is the uniform and character draft to REVISE; image 2 is ONLY her facial-identity reference. The user rejected image 1's thick body, short hair and crossed-leg pose. Make all THREE requested changes clearly and substantially visible: (1) a significantly more slender overall physique, (2) long hair, (3) a genuinely different pose. Keep this same clearly adult fictional woman in her mid-20s, with the same soft oval facial identity, warm brown eyes, delicate nose and gentle pink-lipped smile. Keep the existing white/black/magenta LG tailored uniform design and its refined silver hardware, small chest crest, fitted black mini skirt and black heeled ankle boots.
BODY REVISION IS THE TOP PRIORITY: change the entire frame to a slender, light, elegant fashion-illustration physique. Narrower shoulders and upper arms, appreciably slimmer ribcage and torso, smaller natural bust projection, narrower hips, clearly slimmer upper thighs and tapered slim calves and ankles. The white jacket and skirt must fit the new narrower body, not keep the broad curvy silhouette of the old draft. Reduce the broad/full outer contours throughout by roughly 20–25 percent as a visual direction, keeping realistic joints and a healthy adult silhouette; no emaciation, protruding bones, extreme waist pinching, stretched anatomy, or tiny head. Make the refinement readable at full-image size. Preserve the face and adult character identity; the original nurse's full body shape is NOT to be copied now.
HAIR: replace the shoulder-length bob with long smooth dark-espresso hair reaching to the waist, a soft side part and subtle loose waves toward the ends. Most of the hair falls behind the shoulders/back so the thin waist, arms and uniform tailoring stay visible. Controlled natural locks, not huge fluffy hair or many tangled strands.
POSE: replace the crossed-leg hip pose completely. Turn the shoulders and torso about 20 degrees in an elegant three-quarter standing stance; face turned gently toward the viewer. Weight on one straight supporting leg; the other foot placed slightly forward and to the side. Both knees and ankles are separate and visible, legs NOT crossed. One hand lightly holds the jacket lapel near the upper chest with relaxed accurate fingers; the other arm hangs naturally a little away from her side. No hand on the hip, no exaggerated back arch. Full head-to-toe framing, both boots and heels fully visible, generous modest margins top and bottom.
Retain the high-end soft semi-real painterly game-art face and refined white, black, magenta and silver materials. Keep the elegant LG clan gallery environment and branding as subdued background context. No text except the existing LG emblem. No UI, border, watermark, title or comparisons. One single polished revised illustration. The final silhouette must look distinctly slimmer than image 1, with unmistakably long hair and a new uncrossed stance.
